name: Dr.Bokeh protocol recovery v2: fixed 11-scene input-permission diagnostic

branches.full_public: Reuse saved LDF + LaMa two-layer outputs and metrics; no oracle inputs
branches.gt_alpha: Replace LDF only with existing PNG8 union alpha of all four synthetic foregrounds; retain official RGBAD2layers, cv2 foreground depth repair and LaMa RGB/depth repair
branches.oracle_layers: Four known RGBA foreground assets plus known background, front to back; bypass LDF and all inpainting; original Dr.Bokeh multi-layer renderer

fixed.geometry: Per-frame visible disparity min/max; focus transformed by the same values; K_Dr=K*span; no clamp

oracle_disparity: Quantize each known plane 1/z to PNG8/255 before applying the SAME visible-input min/max. Verify reconstructed visible disparity PNG exactly. Do not add continuous-depth precision as another factor.
asset_checks: Known layers must reproduce the existing sRGB RGB PNG, foreground-union alpha PNG and thresholded visible disparity PNG exactly before rendering
limits: Synthetic composition assets are not independent physical foreground color truth.
The five-layer branch jointly changes layer count, hidden RGB, alpha and geometry; it is not a pure LaMa ablation.
Oracle improvement does not establish what Any-to-Bokeh's unpublished adapter used.
Eleven-scene FVD/VFID must be compared on the identical eleven scenes, not against the paper's 200-scene numbers.
Eight prior preflight scenes and three posthoc failure cases are a selected development diagnostic, not held-out validation.
FVD covariance is across video feature vectors; it does not uniquely measure temporal flicker.
No gamma, geometry or blur-strength search in this stage; no automatic change to Table 1A or frozen 200-scene baseline.
